name: What is the most effective way to determine an accurate listing price for my FSBO property?

mainEntity.name: What is the most effective way to determine an accurate listing price for my FSBO property?

acceptedAnswer.text: To determine an accurate listing price for your For Sale By Owner (FSBO) property, a comparative market analysis (CMA) is crucial. This involves analyzing recent sales of similar homes in your specific neighborhood, like Aventura or Coral Gables, and considering their features, condition, and sale prices. Neglecting a thorough CMA can lead to overpricing, causing your home to sit on the market, or underpricing, resulting in lost equity. An experienced agent can provide a precise CMA, factoring in local market nuances that online tools might miss.
acceptedAnswer.description: A comparative market analysis (CMA) of recently sold, similar homes in your specific neighborhood is the most effective way to determine an accurate listing price for your FSBO property.
